test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In February 2025, how much total budget was allocated to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in the Union Budget?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**₹3,790 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Budget for 2025** allocated a total of **₹3,790 crore** to the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• This allocation reflects the government's commitment to **promoting sports and youth development** in India.
 
• The budget aims to enhance the implementation of initiatives under schemes such as **Khelo India** and **Fit India Movement**.
 
• It also focuses on strengthening **infrastructure development for sporting activities** across the country.
 
• The allocation will help in boosting **sports facilities, athlete training programs, and youth engagement initiatives.**
 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports plays a pivotal role in fostering talent and promoting a **sporting culture among the youth.**
 
• Increased funding ensures better opportunities for **India's representation in international sports events**, including the **Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Focus of Union Budget 2025**__

 __
 
• The Union Budget 2025 emphasized **inclusive growth**, with significant investments in **healthcare, education, and sports.**
 
• It prioritized **human resource development** by allocating funds for schemes promoting **youth skill development and employment generation.**
 
• Increased funding for the sports sector aligns with India's vision of becoming a **global leader in sports.**
 
 
 
• **Other Ministries' Allocations**__
 __
 
• The **Ministry of Education** received a substantial allocation to further the goals of the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.**
 
• The **Ministry of Health** saw an increase in funds to boost **public health infrastructure** and combat future pandemics.
 
 
 
• **Role of Khelo India Scheme**__
 
 
• The **Khelo India Scheme** aims to identify and nurture young talent through **structured training programs.**
 
• It provides funding for **building sports infrastructure** and organizing **multi-disciplinary sports events.**
 
• This scheme plays a crucial role in achieving the objectives of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 

75
